title: András Bay to Ferenc Rákóczi II, Jászvásár 8 March 1706 (DECODE R478)

steps.what: Fetched R478 record, DECODE transcription and both page images with the project cookie.
Fetched the 94 G15 key transcriptions (R549-R646) and scored each on R478 by coverage and Hungarian 4-gram score (score_keys.py).
R609 ranked first (98% coverage, -2.57/char) and gave running Hungarian; R561 second.
Checked DECODE's transcription line by line against the images; 7 corrections (iv->10, 0->clear é, 1257->127, 74 and 63 restored, etc.).
decode.py: 414 groups, 413 with R609 values, 50 = ba from context; one ~10-group stretch reads letter by letter without clear sense.
Web search (Hungarian) for Bay's 1706 Moldavian despatches: no edition or decipherment found.

Correction reported while quotations were pulled for Lasry's list: the normalised Hungarian had drifted from R478_read.txt in five places, each checked against the R609 group values and the images and corrected: 'vissza is ment' (was 'viszaismét [elment]'; group 81 = n), 'a moszkva békességre kéri a svédet' with no 13 = hogy (was 'hogy ... békességet kéri a svédtől'), 'minden elvött várakat', all the fortresses taken (was 'mindenekelőtt várakat'), 'Pekri uram általa' (was 'által'), 'minden szándéka' (was 'mindenben szándéka'). English corrected to match; decrypt, counts and key unchanged.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): linked R478_transcription.txt (DECODE's transcription corrected against the images) and R478_read.txt (raw key output); copied the normalised reading with its English gist from NOTES.md to texts/R478_decryption.md.

Verification 5 (plain-bar rows): R478 was listed as English; the text is Hungarian (1706). Body written to texts/R478_reading.md under a ## Reading heading, gist to texts/R478_en.md, language set to hu. hu word list does not know the period text (plain 0.059), so the explicit-hole share is the bar: 0.706 (12/17). Keeps read.
Read bar applied per document (v10): 1 of 1 documents marked read measure under 95% of words read as sense (v2_score explicit holes) and are now read in part; read_share recorded for each.

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: DECODE never linked a key to R478; decrypting it with each of the 94 G15 key transcriptions (score_keys.py, Hungarian 4-gram) picked Rakoczi's syllabic key R609, which then read the letter unchanged.
outcome.fraction_read_source: decode.py over R478_transcription.txt: 414 cipher groups all given values; ~10 groups in one p. 2 stretch read letter by letter but not as sense, counted unread (404/414).
outcome.notes: Report from the Moldavian court: Muscovite and Polish envoys, Tsar seeking peace with Charles XII, Pekri's message to the voivode, the Swede at Vilna.

credits.note: Rákóczi chancery syllabic key, DECODE R609, read the letter unchanged

texts.label: Bay to Rákóczi, Jászvásár 8 Mar 1706
texts.summary: András Bay reports to Ferenc Rákóczi II from Jászvásár (Iași, Moldavia) that Muscovite and Polish envoys have come to the voivode's court and that the Tsar is asking the Swede for peace, offering back the fortresses taken and his war expenses; Pekri has sent word to the voivode that, once Rákóczi settles the Hungarians' affairs with the Emperor, his whole intention is war against the Turk; the Swede has moved to Vilna.

reading_review.note: v5 check 23 Oct 2026: the plain-bar list took this entry as English (no language field; the sweep scored the whole decryption file, English gist included: plain 0.29, explicit 0.839). The text is Hungarian of 1706, which the hu word list does not know (plain 0.059 on the body alone), so the explicit-hole share is the bar. Body under a ## Reading heading in texts/R478_reading.md (English gist in R478_en.md): explicit 0.706 (12/17), hole rate 0.097. Read as a reader the sentences hold except the stretch on the interpreter ('[? ha az … asseráltad-é ?]') and the opening conditional about the Swede. Keeps read; language set to hu.

texts.note: 24 Oct 2026: 94.2% of the words of texts/R478_reading.md read as sense (v2_score explicit holes); coherent sentences but under the 95% read bar, so read in part.
